title: Kissed Shandong Fish Bao
description: A comforting, fermented bao sandwich with caramelized onion, mayo‑enhanced cod, and chewy Shandong‑style buns.
instructions: Pat the cod fillet dry, season with salt and pepper, and steam it over high heat until cooked through, about 8 minutes.
Slice the steamed cod into bite‑sized pieces and set aside to cool slightly.
In a bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, fermented black bean sauce, soy sauce, sugar, grated ginger, and minced garlic until smooth.
Stir the cooled cod into the mayo mixture, ensuring each piece is evenly coated.
Heat a pan over medium heat, add the caramelized onion, and stir‑fry for 2 minutes until warm.
Toss the onion into the fish mixture and sprinkle corn starch, mixing gently to bind.
Open each bao bun, spoon the fish filling into the center, close the buns, and serve immediately.
If desired, warm the bao buns briefly in a steamer or microwave for 30 seconds before serving.
